item.title: Misbegotten: Runaway Nun #1
item.description: In a post-apocalyptic world gone medieval, the Church sends their top monk warrior to infiltrate a renegade scientist’s enclave and kidnap the J-Clone, the Lord’s vat-born twin. Saving the holy clone from the cross forces, the monk must confront the truth of his own (very immaculate) birth. Clones of Marilyn Monroe, Hitler, Gandhi and Jesus… oh my! Misbegotten is cyber-punk religion gone mad!

item.title: Misbegotten: Runaway Nun #2
item.description: The Pope orders the kidnapping of the Lord’s body double from the Harlequin Island. Father Elano makes his way to the Domus Mariae, the carrier-turned-abbey. Motley gladiators and augmented Steampunk Templars clash. And Klaudette: the one-eyed geisha blood trafficker from the replica ghetto enters the mix.

item.title: Misbegotten: Runaway Nun #3
item.description: Sir Gottfrey arrives aboard Domus Mariae searching for Double-M. Father Micon takes the bullets intended for Elano and dies in his disciple’s arms. On Harlequin Island, Brother Ziggy, a Sigmund Freud-replika-turned-monk, takes runaway replikas to the rendezvous point with the Franciscans’ submarine that has Elano on board. Once inside the replika ghetto, Elano stumbles into the crossfire between two rival gangs and ends up captured by Klaudette.

item.title: Misbegotten: Runaway Nun #4
item.description: Klaudette, the one-eyed geisha, stages her latest show: the raping and killing of Father Elano. With the help of his feral Cannies, King Richie’s renegade warriors crash her party and throw her to the sharks. Later, Richie and Elano strike a deal: to aid the Jesuit in his pursuit of J-Clone, Richie will facilitate Elano’s entrance into Sir Gottfrey’s stronghold in exchange for a free pass off the island.

item.title: Broken Moon: Legends of the Deep #3
item.description: Korbin and his entourage of gill men have been saved from a Kraken attack by none other than Avery, David, and Keeney the Franken-werewolf! But how do Avery and Keeney know the same melody that always calms Keeney down from a rage? Old loyalties are unearthed and underwater nuclear meltdown looms in this latest issue of the hit series. Note: The digital edition (2/1/2017) for this issue was released before the print edition.

item.title: Broken Moon: Legends of the Deep #4
item.description: It finally becomes clear what the nuclear meltdowns have awoken: Cthulhu, the Old One, and his legacy of madness. While Lorren becomes obsessed and begins to pursue the giant god; Korbin, Keeney, David, and Avery search for allies in the form of their former enemies: vampires.

item.title: Broken Moon: Legends of the Deep #6
item.description: The vile threat of Cthulhu has brought every mythical monster together once again to defeat him! But a crazed, Cthulhu-mad Lorren will not be easily shut down, and when he threatens Korbin’s son, the claws of the wolf come out. "Monster mash" takes on a whole new meaning in this action-packed conclusion to the second Broken Moon mini-series!

item.title: Broken Moon: Legends of the Deep #5
item.description: Korbin, David, Avery, Keeney, and To’klace, along with their reluctant vampire allies, set out by boat to find the only creature who might be able to stop Cthulhu and the Tok-tok: Dagon. But Dagon is guarded by sea serpents and not even guaranteed to awaken, and Cthulhu is spreading a madness akin to nuclear radiation. The evocative horror art of Nat Jones brings the latest chapter of AGP’s post-apocalyptic hit to thrilling life! Note: The digital edition (6/7/2017) for this issue was released before the print edition.
